capability: Check every pushed contract against its shape rules
title: Every push meets the gate.

hook.picture: Close on the whale sliding one new card onto a shared line. It looks fine. A pod reading the line chokes on it.
hook.words: My file looked fine to me.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: My file looked fine to me. Then the viewer broke for everyone.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer pushing a new contract file

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three badly shaped cards land: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each one stalls a pod.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nobody checks the file at the door.

stakes.body: One badly shaped file breaks the shared viewer for every reader, and nobody knows which push did it.

solution_hint: Check every file the moment it lands.

metaphor.body: Every new card passes a gate right where it lands. The gate's lintel shows the card's outline: if the shape does not fit, the gate closes and a flag goes up.

steps.picture: A gate stands at the landing spot. Its lintel shows a card outline. A well-shaped card passes and the gate glows.
steps.words: Every file is checked as it lands.
steps.sound: Latch click on the pass glow.

steps.picture: A card with a missing corner reaches the gate. The gate closes and a rust flag goes up beside it.
steps.words: The shape rules have a name: schema.
steps.sound: A muted latch, then a flag flutter.

steps.picture: Push-in. The refused card bounces back to the whale that sent it. The shared line beyond stays clean and the pods keep reading.
A ring pulses at the gate on every push that follows: pass, pass, stop, pass.
steps.words: It runs on every push, every time.

real_case.claim: On 22 Sep 2026 the sheaf / validate check failed on main nine times in a row inside six minutes, each failing in 5-8 seconds with 3 annotations; the cause is recorded only as a config or validation error.

source.title: Fix the failing sheaf / validate CI job on manutej/cell-sheaf-swarm main (9 consecutive red runs)

honest_limit.picture: A card with perfect corners but the wrong colour inside passes the gate, which glows. Downstream, a pod reads it and answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: Right shape, wrong content. It passes.

not_this.body: The check reads shape, not meaning.

ending_pattern.body: The same bad card bounces off the gate at the landing spot, the shared line stays clean, and the pods keep reading.
ending_pattern.callback: The card that stalled three pods in bars 2 to 4 now bounces at the door, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Put a shape check on every push.

score_self.reason: The pain and the gate are clear, but they're generic CI. The sheaf is nearly invisible, and the real run shows the check firing, not catching a known bad output. The limit is honest and drawn.
